coordinates.class_docstring:
Model of the antenna_name coordinate, used in the main dataset (single dish data, :py:class:`VisibilityXds`)
and several sub-datasets such as antenna_xds, pointing_xds, weather_xds, system_calibration_xds, gain_curve_xds, etc.
coordinates.name: antenna_name
station_name
coordinates.docstring: Name of the station pad (relevant to arrays with moving antennas).

coordinates.name: mount
telescope_name
coordinates.docstring: Useful when data is combined from mutiple arrays for example ACA + ALMA.

coordinates.name: polarization_type
coordinates.docstring:
Polarization type to which each receptor responds (e.g. ”R”,”L”,”X” or ”Y”).
This is the receptor polarization type as recorded in the final correlated data (e.g. ”RR”); i.e.
as measured after all polarization combiners. ['X','Y'], ['R','L']

coordinates.name: gain_curve_type
poly_term
coordinates.docstring: Term orders in gain curve polynomial

data_vars.name: GAIN_CURVE
data_vars.docstring: Coeﬃcients of the polynomial that describes the (power or voltage) gain.

data_vars.class_docstring: Quantity with units of K/Jy (sensitivity in gain curve)
data_vars.name: GAIN_CURVE_SENSITIVITY
data_vars.docstring: Sensitivity of the antenna expressed in K/Jy. This is what AIPS calls “DPFU”.

attributes.name: measured_date
attributes.docstring: Date gain curve was measured. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSS (ISO 8601)

attributes.name: type
attributes.docstring: Type of dataset. Expected to be ``gain_curve``

class_docstring: Gain curve dataset. See See https://casacore.github.io/casacore-notes/265.pdf for a full description.
